overview.Name: Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation
overview.Description: Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation operates as a wholesaler and e-commerce provider for the entertainment industry worldwide. It offers vinyl records, video games, digital video discs, blu-rays, toys, compact discs, collectibles, and other entertainment and consumer products. The company also provides third party logistics products and services. It distributes its physical media, entertainment products, hardware, and accessories through multi-channel strategy. The company exports its products. Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation was founded in 1990 and is based in Plantation, Florida.
